resolved_items.new_text: Given a stack profile declares its architecture rules as structured entries, when the profile is checked, then every bundled profile is still reported valid, and an old-style list of plain sentences is accepted too.

new_fr.title: Structured stack profile architecture rules
new_fr.summary: Lets stack profiles declare architecture rules as structured entries while keeping old plain lists and bundled profiles valid.

resolved_items.new_text: Given a profile still uses the old plain-sentence list of architecture rules, when the profile is checked on request, then a warning is shown, and no other phase prints that warning.

new_fr.title: Warning for outdated architecture rule format in profiles
new_fr.summary: Tells users when a profile still uses the old plain-sentence architecture rules, shown only when they request a check.

resolved_items.new_text: Given one architecture rule names both a linter fragment and a list of checking files, when the profile is checked on request, then that rule is reported as an error, the remaining rules stay usable, and the profile itself stays valid.

new_fr.title: Architecture rule validation within a project profile
new_fr.summary: This makes sure a project profile flags any architecture rule that names both a linter fragment and checking files, while keeping the other rules usable and the profile valid.

resolved_items.new_text: Given the list of allowed ways a rule can be kept is copied into the profile checker, when the tests run, then a test fails as soon as that copy differs from the constitution register, and the constitution register tests still pass.
